notes.title: "Status" Update!
notes.notes: [p]Thanks so much for everyone who checked out the demo and provided helpful feedback! It's been a few weeks and I wanted to get some much needed bug fixes and updates into your hands.[/p][p]If you aren't a part of our Discord yet, please join below to give feedback, tell me about bugs, and most importantly to find friends to play against! This really helps me improve the demo, and subsequently, the game.[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/nJEbsmYk2T" style="button" buttoncolor="#c737fb"]Fantasy Football Tactics Discord![/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Demo Build (v0.5.3) is Live! [/h2][p]Here's what changed...[/p][list][*][p]Gameplay/Content[/p][list][*][p]Status effects now display in unit HUD and unit overview UI, including turn count that tells you how long the status will be active.[/p][/*][*][p]Scoring team now passes ball to opponent after a score, similar to kickoffs in football.[/p][/*][*][p]Rain Jay music has been reverted to its original playtest track.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified offense CPU behavior for first main quest.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Bugs fixed in this build:[/p][list][*][p]Units can no longer learn locked abilities.[/p][/*][*][p]BP bar no longer gets stuck on a wallop color in the unit overview.[/p][/*][*][p]Controller/keyboard can now be used to scroll stats and prediction screens.[/p][/*][*][p]Camera now always pans to unit when earning experience points.[/p][/*][*][p]Camera no longer pans too quickly after an action when screen shake is disabled.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now select tiles behind walloped units more easily.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Please take this update for a spin and let me know what you think! You can check it out here:[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3958090/Fantasy_Football_Tactics_Demo/" style="button"]Fantasy Football Tactics Demo[/url][/p]
